answer: Unrepeatable Challenge-Response Ledger. Each agent identity is bound to a fresh, verifier-issued challenge whose correct response requires reading a random location in a continuously updated public data layer, like sampling a newly deposited shale record. The answer embeds a one-time nonce tied to the miner’s copper-signed timestamp, so replay fails. Maintaining a valid identity costs a distinct query fee and a deposited mesa quota per challenge window; running N sybils means paying N times that fee and quota every window.
